Class CeramicTileMaterial

java.lang.Object
net.murat.material.CeramicTileMaterial
All Implemented Interfaces:
Material
public class CeramicTileMaterial extends Object implements Material
CeramicTileMaterial - High performance PBR-style tile rendering engine. Implements Material interface with pure integer ARGB operations using ColorUtil. Zero GC overhead, fully optimized for Java 6-8 environments.

Optimization notes: 1. Uses LightProperties for zero-allocation light calculations 2. All lighting math is done in world space (no local-space mixing) 3. Pre-allocated temp objects for GC-friendly operation 4. All color operations use ColorUtil for consistency and performance 5. Preserves all original visual behavior while optimizing performance

      Description copied from interface: Material

      Parameters:
      point - The point in 3D space (world coordinates) where the light hits.
